sources.label: Official AllSaints size guide (men's clothing, cm; men's conversion chart)

audit: Labels were 'XS (34)' etc. with chest/waist only. Official men's chart: XS–XXXL = UK/US 34–46; chest and waist were 0.5–1 cm off (XS chest 87 → 86.5, waist 71 → 72; XL waist 92 → 92.5; XXL waist 97 → 97.5; XXXL chest 117 → 116.5, waist 102 → 102.5). Added seat/full hip (90–120) and EU from the men's conversion chart (44–54; XXXL has no EU there, so none stored). Old /pages/size-guide URL is gone.
notes: UK urban-luxury brand. Slim modern fit. Chest sizes 34–46 (XS–XXXL). Trousers use waist size in inches (28–42).
